universal_guidelines: Dark Mode Default: The app must start in dark mode. Background is #09090b.
Orange & Blue Pulse: Use Orange (#FF6B35) for user actions and Blue (#00B4D8) for system status.
No Pure Black: Avoid #000000. Use #09090b or #18181b for surfaces.
Bento Grid: The dashboard must use a dense grid layout with distinct functional zones.
Data-Test-ID: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Font: Use 'Manrope' for headings and 'Public Sans' for body text.
Responsiveness: Ensure the 3-column layout stacks vertically on mobile.
Chinese Typography: Ensure line-height is relaxed (1.6) for better Chinese character readability.
Glass Headers: Top navigation should be sticky and glassmorphic.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update tailwind.config.js to extend the theme with new colors and radius.
2. Replace CSS variables in index.css with the new dark theme values.
3. Refactor App.js to remove hardcoded light background colors.
4. Update DashboardPage.jsx to use the new Bento Grid layout classes.
5. Ensure the Logo URL is updated in the Login and Dashboard headers.
6. Verify all text contrast ratios against the dark background.
